notes: A split-screen login. The left column has the todoist logo, 'Welcome back!', stacked Google, Facebook and Apple buttons, then email and password fields with a red Log in button, a forgot-password link, terms text and a sign-up link. The right panel is a peach illustration of a calendar, phone and plant with a 'Take Todoist with you' mobile-app prompt and a QR code. The requesting app and the data:read_write scope are not mentioned.
